name: Redridge Mountains
summary: Redridge Mountains now face attacks from Shadowhide gnolls and Blackrock orcs of the Dark Horde. Rushing rivers run through wooded slopes around Lake Everstill, while Lakeshire holds the line with wandering mercenaries as Stormwind’s forces contend with strife at home.

sections.title: A Bastion Under Siege
sections.body: Redridge once stood among the kingdom’s most peaceful regions. Its forests supplied Stormwind with timber, while its waters and fields gave the kingdom fish and crops. Now Lakeshire is fortified against repeated attacks. Stonewatch Keep, once a proud stronghold of the kingdom, has fallen to renegade Blackrock orcs. Their hold cuts off roads and threatens the eastern valleys.

sections.title: The Divided Range
sections.body: These peaks form part of the spine that runs down the subcontinent of Azeroth. Centuries ago, the range stretched much farther north. Then the Dark Iron clan accidentally summoned the Firelord Ragnaros, and the earth split open to form the fiery crater of Blackrock Mountain. The cataclysm severed the northern peaks into the ash-choked Burning Steppes. Only the southern Redridge valleys remain lush and green, exposed to attacks from the slopes above.

sections.title: Neglected by the Crown
sections.body: Magistrate Solomon and Marshal Marris plead for reinforcements, but Stormwind’s regency council leaves Lakeshire to fend for itself. Appeals to Sentinel Hill and Darkshire bring no aid; both settlements are crippled by crises of their own. With no reinforcements in sight, local magistrates hire any capable sellsword willing to brave the Lakeridge Highway, clear the gnoll camps, and push back the danger across Lake Everstill.

sections.title: The Hidden Allegiances
sections.body: Morganth, a rogue warlock, first allied with the Blackrock orcs to seize Stonewatch Keep. Later, he betrayed them and bound the Shadowhide gnolls to his service from the Tower of Ilgalar. Reports recovered during the Blackrock investigation also reveal an alliance between the orcs and the black dragonflight.

faq.q: Why won't Stormwind send soldiers to help Lakeshire?
faq.answer: Lakeshire’s surviving royal soldiers are badly outnumbered after the fall of Stonewatch Keep. Magistrate Solomon has appealed for troops, weapons, food, and supplies, but Stormwind’s forces are stretched thin, and nearby settlements face troubles of their own. The garrison relies on adventurers to help hold the region.

Blackrock orcs of the Dark Horde control Stonewatch Keep. From the mountain stronghold, they threaten the eastern valleys and travelers on the Lakeridge Highway. Their ties to other local threats come to light during the investigation.

faq.q: What threats dwell in Lake Everstill?
faq.answer: Hostile murloc tribes infest Lake Everstill and raid nearby docks and ruins. Predatory threshadons also hunt beneath the surface, giving rise to rumors of aquatic monsters in the depths.

faq.q: Are there any Horde outposts in Redridge?
faq.answer: Redridge has no Horde settlements, vendors, or flight paths. Horde travelers passing through are generally traveling between the Burning Steppes to the north and the Swamp of Sorrows to the southeast, along Alliance-held roads and through hostile wilderness.

The Three Corners is a crossroads in southwest Redridge. It joins the Lakeridge Highway to Elwynn Forest’s eastern border and the road into Duskwood, making it a vital passage often targeted by wandering gnolls and wild beasts.

faq.q: Why is the northern path to the Burning Steppes so perilous?
faq.answer: The trail north past Render’s Camp climbs straight into the Burning Steppes, a desolate volcanic wasteland ruled by powerful Blackrock orcs, fire elementals, and dragonkin. The sudden rise in danger makes the northern mountain pass one of southern Azeroth’s deadliest climbs.

angles.text: As an Alliance soldier, you can hone your skills in Lakeshire, a frontline hub facing organized orcs and gnolls.
The Blackrock orcs entrenched in Redridge belong to the hostile Dark Horde. They are enemies of Thrall’s Horde as well as the humans in Lakeshire.
You can find copper, tin, and rare silver veins in the rocky crags and valleys around Lake Everstill, especially near the Rethban Caverns.
The temperate mountain slopes support Briarthorn, Bruiseweed, Mageroyal, and Swiftthistle.
